newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAP says Eurotunnel max risk 75 mln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: UAP says Eurotunnel max risk 75 mln Ffr.

text.p: French insurer UAP said on Tuesday it was impossible to quantify yet the cost of damage caused by last week's Eurotunnel fire but that its maximum residual risk totalled 75 million francs ($14.5 million).
"The maximum residual risk for UAP, if all the contract guarantees were invoked, would be 75 million francs," Union des Assurances de Paris said in a statement.
It added that, "Up to now, there is no reliable estimate of the amount of damage caused by the fire on November 18 in the south tunnel".
UAP, one of the lead insurers for the Anglo-French channel tunnel operator, said the residual risk figure took into account its reinsurance cover.
It said its contract with Eurotunnel was shared out among many insurers and reinsurers throughout the world but did not identify them.
It said investigations were under way to assess the extent of the damage to the tunnel's concrete fabric and that the results would not be known for many days.
Operational losses proportional to the length of the disruption in service could not be assessed until results were known from studies under way and repair work to be undertaken, UAP said.
It said one of the tracks of the Eurotunnel shuttle had been virtually destroyed by the fire but that its policy with the channel operator did not cover that damage.
